dedupe_keys.name: new zealand trauma registry national major trauma patient records iss over 12 or injury death with national minimum dataset

description: The New Zealand Trauma Registry records every patient with major injuries admitted to an acute hospital in the country, giving a consistent national description of severely injured patients for quality improvement, benchmarking and research. It is run by the National Trauma Network within Health New Zealand Te Whatu Ora as a single web-based system used by all acute hospitals. Coverage is national and continuous; patients are included when their Injury Severity Score exceeds 12 on the 2015 Abbreviated Injury Scale or when they die from injury, including in the emergency department, with published exclusions such as isolated hip fractures and in-hospital falls. Each record follows the national minimum data set for major trauma, agreed for mandatory collection, and summary figures are published in a National Major Trauma Dashboard and monthly trauma reports. Record-level data are free but not available as an open download: researchers and quality improvement teams apply through an online form and a weekly data governance review. Caveats: access is limited and prioritised, less severe injuries are excluded, and dashboards give only summaries. Simulation uses: setting major trauma arrival rates, transfer patterns and severity mixes for trauma system, retrieval and emergency department capacity models, including mass casualty scenarios. Related records: the NMDS hospital events (data-nz-nmds-hospital-events) cover all admissions, and NEMSIS (data-nemsis-research-dataset) is a US pre-hospital counterpart.

schema_summary: One record per major trauma patient admitted to an acute hospital in New Zealand, with the data elements of the national minimum data set for major trauma (injury severity coded with AIS 2015); inclusion ISS greater than 12 or death following injury including in the emergency department

sources.note: NZTR Te Rēhita Whētuki o Aotearoa: the single web-based system collecting all major trauma patient data for people admitted to acute hospitals in New Zealand; data access subject to strict guidelines (data use SOP, online research request form, weekly review by the national data governance group); check the National Major Trauma Dashboard or NZTR Monthly Trauma Report first; national minimum data set for major trauma; inclusion ISS greater than 12 (AIS 2015) or death following injury including in the ED; exclusions such as delayed admission over 7 days, isolated neck of femur fracture, in-hospital falls
